title: Structural insights into DNA annealing and recombination by herpesviral DNA-binding proteins ICP8 and BALF2
authors: Girish R. Apte; Shuvankar Patra; Mariusz Czarnocki-Cieciura; Aqsa Jabeen; Justyna Jackiewicz; Jarosław Poznański; Marcin Nowotny; Małgorzata Figiel
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构解析疱疹病毒DNA结合蛋白ICP8/BALF2与DNA复合物，揭示DNA退火与重组机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构研究，但未采用AI或物理模拟方法，且对象非典型TF-DNA体系。
abstract: The DNA-binding proteins of herpesviruses are key factors involved in multiple stages of DNA replication and recombination. The well-studied ICP8 protein of Herpes Simplex Virus 1 binds single-stranded DNA in a cooperative manner and facilitates the annealing of complementary DNA strands in a process that involves the formation of double helical filaments. Moreover, it cooperates with UL12 alkaline nuclease to execute recombination between homologous DNA sequences. In this work, we present the structures of ICP8 and its homolog BALF2 of the Epstein-Barr Virus in complexes with DNA. These structures reveal a conserved conformation of the bound DNA in which several bases are rotated away from the protein, enabling homology search and base-pairing. The crystal structures of ICP8-DNA depict the pairing between two DNA strands, showing the flexibility of base-pairing. In the structure of the double filament of ICP8, we visualize the interactions between protein subunits within and between the antiparallel strands. Finally, we present the first complete structure of a ternary recombinase complex composed of ICP8 and UL12 bound to a model DNA. This structural landscape illustrates the different stages of the DNA recombination process in herpesviruses, shedding light on molecular mechanisms of their replication.
abstract_zh: 疱疹病毒的DNA结合蛋白是参与DNA复制和重组多个阶段的关键因子。已被深入研究的单纯疱疹病毒1型ICP8蛋白以协同方式结合单链DNA，并在涉及双螺旋丝状结构形成的过程中促进互补DNA链的退火。此外，它与UL12碱性核酸酶协同作用，执行同源DNA序列之间的重组。在本研究中，我们展示了ICP8及其在EB病毒中的同源物BALF2与DNA复合物的结构。这些结构揭示了结合DNA的保守构象，其中数个碱基旋转远离蛋白质，从而促进同源搜索和碱基配对。ICP8-DNA的晶体结构描绘了两条DNA链之间的配对，展示了碱基配对的灵活性。在ICP8双丝状结构体中，我们可视化了反平行链内及链间蛋白质亚基之间的相互作用。最后，我们首次呈现了由ICP8和UL12结合模型DNA组成的三元重组酶复合物的完整结构。这一结构图谱阐明了疱疹病毒DNA重组过程的不同阶段，为其复制分子机制提供了见解。
